description: This Java class implements an event handling strategy for the PolicyIdModified event within the Ditto framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides a method to update a ThingBuilder with a modified policy ID.

classes.name: PolicyIdModifiedStrategy
classes.description: An immutable strategy class that handles PolicyIdModified events by updating a ThingBuilder with the new policy entity ID.

methods.name: PolicyIdModifiedStrategy()
methods.description: Constructor for PolicyIdModifiedStrategy class, calls superclass constructor.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply the PolicyIdModified event to a ThingBuilder, setting the policy ID from the event.
